title: C++ Under Pressure: A Complete Interview Guide from 1,000+ Interviews
excerpt: C++ interview guide from an interviewer who's conducted 1,000+ interviews. Covers memory model, vtables, lock-free, low-latency & more. 13 chapters.
content_html:
Written by the interviewer , not the candidate

About

Most C++ interview guides teach you syntax. This one teaches you what interviewers are actually testing.

Written by a Technical Lead who has conducted 1,000+ interviews for C++ systems roles, this book covers the depth that separates candidates who get offers from those who don't — vtable layout, the memory model, lock-free data structures, undefined behaviour traps, low-latency design, and more.

13 chapters. Interviewer's perspective throughout. Every chapter ends with interview questions formatted the way they actually get asked — read the question, cover the answer, say it out loud.

Not a beginner tutorial. Not an algorithms book. The C++ knowledge that other books skip plus extra free data structures and algorithms cheat sheet.

Author

Ahmed

Ahmed Aly is a Technical Lead with 15+ years of experience in multinational top companies building high-performance, scalable software and ML/AI systems — the kind of software where a garbage collector pause is unacceptable, a Python loop that should have been a NumPy kernel becomes a production incident, and "it works on my machine" is not a shipping standard.

He has conducted more than 1,000 technical interviews for systems and ML/AI engineering roles and has seen the same gaps appear again and again. This book is written from the interviewer's side of the table.

Contents

  • Part 1 — Language Foundations
    • Chapter 1: Compilation & Linking
    • Chapter 2: Memory — Stack, Heap & RAII
    • Chapter 3: OOP & Polymorphism
    • Chapter 4: Move Semantics & Value Categories
    • Chapter 5: Smart Pointers
    • Chapter 6: Templates & Concepts
    • Chapter 7: const, constexpr & Type Deduction
  • Part 2 — Systems & Concurrency
    • Chapter 8: Undefined Behaviour
    • Chapter 9: Multithreading
    • Chapter 10: Memory Model & Lock-Free Programming
    • Chapter 11: Low-Latency & Performance
    • Chapter 12: OS Fundamentals
  • Part 3 — Design
    • Chapter 13: SOLID & Design Patterns
  • Appendices
    • Appendix A: 50 Must-Know Interview Q&A
    • Appendix B: Data Structures Cheat Sheet
    • Appendix C: Algorithms Cheat Sheet
    • Appendix D: Keyword Index
